label: Brc167 system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a gcu167/Brc167 bacteriophage-resistance integron cassette that supports growth during bacteriophage challenge.
observations: Brc167 branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual Brc167 proteins, brc167 nucleotide sequences, attC sites, source database rows naming one gcu167 model, DefenseFinder HMM or rules profiles absent from the pinned snapshot, the broader Bacteriophage Resistance integron Cassettes class, and other mobile-integron phage-defense cassettes.
